I'll create a single variable input for `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (server-only) with a placeholder and clear description. Once provided, I can update Render and verify.Here is the secure box to paste the token:

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN                                    │
│  [paste sbp_... Management API token here]                 │
│                                                           │
│  ⚠️ This is the Management API token from:                 │
│     https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens          │
│  Do NOT paste the project secret key (sb_secret_...).     │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Fill the field below and I'll update Render, verify live, and purge the old leaked token from git history.
